expanse26_opa_command_magazine.name: UNN light torpedo magazine
expanse26_opa_command_magazine.descripti: Eight torpedoes. Fires two every 10 seconds while a detected enemy is available in the same gravity well; reloads 120 seconds after the last pair. 30-second projectile fuel life. Research applies.
expanse21_opa_command.description: An enlarged OPA command cruiser with twice the base hull and armor of Europa’s Bane. Direct colonization, engineering support and guarded boarding. Six existing defensive PDCs and an unchanged eight-torpedo magazine.
expanse21_opa_command_colony_module.name: Colonize
expanse21_opa_command_colony_module.desc: Colonize a nearby eligible neutral planet. Native colony shuttle: range 5000, 120 antimatter, 120-second cooldown; grants one logistics and one commerce capacity. Available directly without fitting an item.
